description: P0-8 seven-scope data-qualification recheck applying the six known audit corrections (fail-closed). Each scope is recorded independently; the ADD scopes are never merged.

corrections_contract.1: miniTTR docstring must NOT claim per-position error is used (removed/fixed).
corrections_contract.2: The three ADD scopes must NEVER be merged; each is its own independent unit.
corrections_contract.3: public/accessibility is NOT a license; a scope is not licensed merely because it is publicly downloadable.
corrections_contract.4: Phase2 Bernoulli sensitivity n=9806/... is count depth, NOT biological replicate N.
corrections_contract.5: constructed identical positions are only a zero-separation control-flow test, not real data.
corrections_contract.6: if any of raw counts / executable action / real marginal cost is missing, the scope is TERMINATED_FOR_CURRENT_DATA (fail-closed).
